HTML reference from the production Kotlin model. This is not a native UI screenshot.
All channels and lists here are synthetic. Buttons select exported model snapshots; they do not stream media.

Groups use server-issued station identities. Every loaded source is visible by default. Country and language labels are provider metadata, not a guarantee about audio tracks.

TV and phone retain their existing Compose components. JVM tests cover the production grouping, raw page cursor and profile/guide isolation. Native focus, large text, pixels and playback require a device.
